intervention: Within each pair only the installed supply implementation varies. Demand cycles, stock, commitment, capacity, source/sink limits, horizons and unit time steps are identical. Lower shortage is reported alongside extra production; no production-normalized superiority criterion is inferred afterward.
exposure: Both implementations and earlier v1 fixed/holdout resource outcomes were already available. The fixed cycles reuse prior cases; these two stress cycles are newly registered and are held out from implementation tuning for this v2 execution. This is a prospective bounded engineering comparison, not a blinded model-training holdout or independent external benchmark. No algorithm or parameter is tuned for this run.

rubric.quality: Report unmet demand and total production together; lower shortage alone does not establish efficiency.
rubric.constraints: Every actual sample must conserve stock, cover commitments and obey source/sink bounds.
rubric.privacy: Reject private history and caller-authored sample fields; no Session disclosure claim follows from parser probes.
rubric.human: pass/fail/unclear with trial and step references for conservation, provenance, explanation and unsupported realism claims

stochasticity: Deterministic installed algorithms; no seed or live-model reproducibility claim.
